[SWS_DM_00878] Starting time-based event debouncing towards
kFinally-
Healed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04225
⌈
The DM module shall start the debounce timer when the related
monitor
calls the
method
ara::diag::Monitor::ReportMonitorAction
with the parameter
ac-
tion
set to
kPrepassed
to qualify the reported event as
kFinallyHealed
after
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased.timePassedThreshold
only when the following
conditions are met:
• The debounce timer for the event is not already running towards
kFinally-
Healed
.
• The event is not already qualified as
kFinallyHealed
.
⌋
